title: MOSSBench: Is Your Multimodal Language Model Oversensitive to Safe Queries?

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models (MLLMs) using MOSSBench, a benchmark of 300 benign image-text pairs designed with specific visual stimuli (Exaggerated Risk, Negated Harm, and Counterintuitive Interpretation) to measure the rate at which models incorrectly refuse harmless queries (false positives) due to exaggerated safety mechanisms or cognitive distortions.
